assumptions.statement: Repository provisional rough polygons are used only as a coherent temporary design canvas.
assumptions.impact: Every precision-sensitive geometry and metric must be recalculated; no edge is a legal parcel, road, heritage, or engineering redline.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Cleared official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons become available.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, heritage controls, utilities, ownership, and existing-building surveys are not available in the cleared package.
assumptions.impact: No parcel approval, demolition, building volume, engineering route, or construction promise is made.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Approved regulatory and specialist-control material becomes available.

assumptions.statement: No public accountable owner, operator, venue agreement, formal-service receiving team, or paid staffing contract is yet confirmed.
assumptions.impact: The proposal cannot open to the public; Gate 0 is a hard prerequisite, not a later administrative task.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Named organisations and named duty roles sign the pilot charter.

assumptions.statement: RAG boundaries are a project design control, not a substitute for service-specific legal, safeguarding, emergency, occupational-safety, or professional review.
assumptions.impact: Red requests are never matched; amber work needs a second human gate; any unresolved incident closes the interface.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Qualified reviewers approve site- and service-specific procedures and complete drills.

assumptions.statement: Every open interface has at least two trained paid people: a public-facing navigator or workshop lead and a duty/safety lead; one coordinator cannot cover two stations or sick leave.
assumptions.impact: Hours shrink to funded staffing; volunteers cannot be used to disguise an unfunded public service.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Payroll, relief cover, roster, training, supervision, and maximum duty load are approved.

assumptions.statement: Volunteer and partner activity is voluntary, unpaid unless a stipend/credit arrangement applies, supervised, low risk, and secondary to paid accountable roles.
assumptions.impact: No solo escort, triage, safeguarding decision, incident handling, private contact, or replacement of statutory/professional duties.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: The operator confirms insurance, role descriptions, consent, training, and refusal/withdrawal routes.

assumptions.statement: Default operation is no-account and data-minimised: request category, station, time band, outcome, referral status, and version only; names, phone numbers, precise traces, passwords, payments, photos, and free-text case histories are not routine inputs.
assumptions.impact: AI works on public or aggregate operational data; sensitive or identifying data requires a separate lawful necessity assessment and human process.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: A service-specific privacy assessment, retention schedule, access control, and deletion test are approved.

assumptions.statement: Repair activity is limited to supervised low-risk materials and non-powered simple objects; high-risk categories remain out of scope.
assumptions.impact: The workshop may refuse any item and refers professional work; it does not promise restored performance, warranty, or liability waiver.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: A qualified workshop operator confirms tools, PPE, isolation, inspection, insurance, and referral partners.

assumptions.statement: Four AI roles only verify sources/routes, flag scope/risk, plan aggregate capacity, and draft public/easy-read versions. They never score people or make final eligibility, priority, safety, diagnosis, legal, procurement, or emergency decisions.
assumptions.impact: Every output has a named human authoriser, override reason, expiry, rollback route, and offline equivalent.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Tabletop tests show red-risk interception, stale-version rollback, and human override working.

assumptions.statement: The 24-week sequence is a decision-gate model, not a construction or government service commitment.
assumptions.impact: No public opening before Gate 0 and Gate 1; no scaling from attendance alone.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: A named owner approves budget, calendar, sites, measures, stop authority, and public status wording.
